en.quote: And she caught him by his garment, saying, Lie with me: and he left his garment in her hand, and fled, and got him out.
en.riddle: caught him by his garment, saying, Lie with me
en.speaker: Potiphar's wife

he.quote: וַתִּתְפְּשֵׂהוּ בְּבִגְדוֹ לֵאמֹר שִׁכְבָה עִמִּי וַיַּעֲזֹב בִּגְדוֹ בְּיָדָהּ וַיָּנָס וַיֵּצֵא הַחֽוּצָה
he.speaker: אשת פוטיפר

en.12: And she caught him by his garment, saying, Lie with me: and he left his garment in her hand, and fled, and got him out.
